description: Generate a new picture on fal. kind photo (default) = Krea 2 Turbo: photos, people, places, moods and other emotional images. kind text = GPT Image 2.5 Flare: only for mockups with a lot of legible lettering. Library first: search picorn_search_icons or use search lines in picorn_blueprint_compile, and generate only when the design would benefit massively from a new picture (no fitting hero photo exists). Generation needs a connected Picorn account with credits; it is charged at 1.2 × the fal price (a Krea 2 Turbo picture of about 1 MP costs about 1 ct). Returns an inline preview, the public imageUrl and chargedCents.

kind.description: photo (default, Krea 2 Turbo) or text (GPT Image 2.5, lettering-heavy mockups).

prompt.description: Detailed English description of the picture.
